### LinkedIn About
I turn messy research into tools that operators can run the next morning.

I spent six years with venture teams who had a thesis and no way to show it. The work is interviews, drafts, and a build a fellow can hand to a customer without translation.

Get older and the work gets quieter, which is the point of this bio.

### Spoken event introduction
Jordan Hale drafts fellow bios from source material and returns a package a person can paste the same day.
